stories.headline: CFPB Revises Complaint Portal After Credit Reporting Surge
stories.body: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) said Wednesday (June 24) that it has made several changes to improve its consumer complaint process, which has been made less effective by a growing number of users who abuse the process. stories.headline: JPMorgan Chase unveils $50 billion buyback, Goldman Sachs raises dividend after Fed stress test
stories.body: The announcements followed the release of the Federal Reserve's annual stress test, which found that all 32 large banks weathered a hypothetical recession.

stories.headline: Deal would merge 2 banks in Michigan's Upper Peninsula
stories.body: Keweenaw Financial plans to acquire neighboring Range Financial in a transaction that would create an institution with nearly $1.7 billion of assets.
